title: Kissed Creamy American Pasta Pilaf
description: A rich and fluffy American pasta dish featuring yuzu, with an al-dente finish, made in a cazuela and suitable for solo dinner, following ayurvedic sattvic friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pasta al-dente according to package instructions, then set aside.
In the cazuela, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the heavy cream, yuzu juice, salt, and black pepper, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the cream sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the grated cheddar until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the cream sauce, tossing to coat.
Transfer the cazuela to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and serve hot.
